call_points.text: July South Africa order of about USD 35 million for nine locomotives not yet in the order book, pending formal agreement.
Mozambique locomotive deliveries targeted to begin by end of this FY, with clarity by end of Q2.
REMCL posted about ₹22 Cr profit this quarter and paid RITES about ₹10 Cr dividend at a 91% payout.
Vande Bharat standard-gauge export prototype discussions with Indian Railways started; no timeline or value given.
Export order book at an all-time high of ₹1,700+ Cr; FY26 export execution was about ₹300 Cr.
Turnkey order book of ₹4,580 Cr, two-thirds young, starts billing substantially over the next one to three quarters.
Turnkey revenue is down about ₹200 Cr; management expects to return to last year's turnkey revenue level in FY27.
Other expenses rose on Mozambique locomotive logistics and warranty provisions; FY27 impact seen as not substantial as Bangladesh moves by rail.
Working capital requirement described as minimal, so competitive orders are not expected to stretch it.
REMCL revenue ₹163 Cr, up 16%, profit ₹90 Cr, up 19%, and paid RITES a ₹42 Cr dividend; it is adding renewable and international consultancy.
Management sees no major execution risk from government capex or raw material costs, but is watching travel costs across 700+ live projects.
High dividend payout model to continue.

operating_notes.text: Order book of ₹9,416 Cr at 31 March 2026, with more than 50% of it 12-18 months old and due to bill in FY27.
Export order book of ₹1,700+ Cr includes 200 Bangladesh coaches; first rake of 20 coaches due in about two months, with three to four rakes minimum targeted in FY27.
REMCL FY26 revenue ₹163 Cr (up 16%) and profit ₹90 Cr (up 19%), paying RITES a ₹42 Cr dividend; QA revenue up 16% and back to FY24 levels with non-IR share now 60%+.
Order book ₹9,450 Cr at 30 June 2026, of which ₹4,700 Cr is turnkey and ₹2,100 Cr is RITES Videsh (₹1,775 Cr rolling stock export, about ₹900 Cr Bangladesh coaches).
Turnkey earns 1.5-2% margins and was 30-33% of Q1FY27 revenue; 70% of fresh order inflows are on a competitive basis.
REMCL posted about ₹22 Cr profit in Q1FY27 and paid RITES about ₹10 Cr dividend at a 91% payout ratio.
